title: Welcome to Quizzy
description: A short tour of Quizzy: your quiz folder, practice flow, knowledge notes, goals, and imports.

questions.prompt: Where does Quizzy look for your quiz `.json` files?
options: Only inside the app install folder
The working directory you choose in Settings
questions.explanation: Quizzy reads and writes quizzes in the working directory you select. You can change it later in Settings.

questions.prompt: How do you begin a scored practice attempt?
options: Open a quiz from the library, then choose Start
By editing Settings first every time
questions.explanation: From Home, open a quiz card and start an attempt. Your answers are scored when you finish.

questions.prompt: Knowledge notes live in a `knowledge-base` folder next to your quizzes and can link to specific questions.
questions.explanation: Quizzy keeps markdown notes under `knowledge-base/`. You can link a note to quiz questions and open it while reviewing.

questions.prompt: Which of these help you improve after practice?
options: Mistake Log for questions you often miss
Goals with a target score on a quiz
questions.explanation: Mistake Log, Goals, and History are built for review. Your working directory should stay available so Quizzy can load your library.

questions.prompt: How can you add more quizzes after this welcome file?
options: Import a `.json` quiz, use How to import / AI prompts, or browse QuizHub if enabled
Only by renaming this welcome quiz
questions.explanation: Use **Import quiz file**, the import help AI prompt, or enable QuizHub in Settings to download curated content. Files you place in the working directory appear after refresh.

questions.prompt: You should treat the working directory as your library: keep quiz JSON and knowledge notes there, and avoid deleting the folder while Quizzy is using it.
questions.explanation: Quizzy expects that folder to stay readable. Back it up like any other documents folder if the content matters to you.
